description: A single action offered by an action surface — the F5 TmMobileActionBar, the F4 overflow toolbar, and any future action host. The model is deliberately free of rendering concerns: a host maps an item to a button, a menu entry, or another surface.

properties.name: Id
properties.description: Stable identity of the action (used as a render key). When empty, Label identifies the item. Must not start with 'tm-' when it lands in a CSS class or id — that prefix is reserved for library-internal stems.

properties.name: Label
properties.description: The user-visible label. Names the rendered button and stays fully in the DOM.

properties.name: Icon
properties.description: Optional icon name (an IconNames value or a registered icon).

properties.name: Priority
properties.description: Overflow rank ONLY — it never changes the render order. The bar and the "More" menu render in the order of Items; the items beyond the visible budget move into the menu by ascending priority (the lowest priority overflows first, ties drop the last item first). Disabled items still count towards the budget.

properties.name: Disabled
properties.description: Disables the action. Disabled items render as disabled buttons/menuitems.

properties.name: OnClick
properties.description: The action itself. Invoked exactly once per user activation. Create the callback with EventCallback.Factory.Create(this, …) — the receiver is the owning component, so its markup re-renders automatically when the action mutates state; a default (empty) callback is a no-op.

properties.name: KeepMenuOpen
properties.description: When true, the "More" menu stays open after the action runs — use for actions that open another surface (a confirm dialog, a picker): the surface promotes AFTER the sheet, so it paints above it (top-layer order = open order), and closing it returns focus to this item. The default closes the sheet BEFORE the action runs: focus returns to the "More" trigger and the action runs with no menu bookkeeping behind it.

examples.title: Edit-mode actions for TmMobileActionBar
